name: ma-registry
description: Finds the vesting deed for a Massachusetts property and extracts a paste-ready legal description from the county registry of deeds.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where reports, legal-description text files, and downloaded deed PDFs are saved. Runs never write anywhere else.

extraction_mode.title: Deed text extraction
extraction_mode.description: 'auto' (default) uses the Anthropic API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present — a faster single-shot run — and otherwise falls back automatically to reading the deed PDF in this session, so no key is required to install or use the plugin. 'claude-code' never calls the API. 'api' forces it and fails with an actionable error if the key is missing. In EVERY mode the registry search, the wrong-parcel guard and the grantor check work without an API key — only the deed's own text extraction differs.

copy_to_clipboard.title: Copy legal description to clipboard
copy_to_clipboard.description: After a successful run, place the paste-ready legal description on the clipboard for pasting into Word or your document system.

write_docx.title: Also write a .docx
write_docx.description: Write the legal description as a Word document alongside the .txt. Requires the python-docx package; silently skipped if unavailable.

show_timings.title: Show run timings
show_timings.description: Record how long each stage takes and print a timing summary at the end of the report. Timings stay on your machine and are never transmitted.
